title: 第六十六章 野火燎原四万里 烈焰焚村又遭殃第六十五章 狂飙卷地狂风起 飞沙走石又逢灾
content_zh:
诗曰：
狂飙初歇土尘凉，赤地枯干引火殃。
万里烽烟连碧落，千村烈焰断人肠。
众人离了风陵村，继续向西前行。大旱日久，天地燥气凝而不散，遍野草木早已枯焦如炭，遍地黄土干硬似陶，连风中都裹挟着一股灼热气息。方才狂风过境，折木扬尘，断枝败叶散落四野，处处皆是引火之物，隐患暗藏。
何日行走在路上，脚踩枯枝，耳畔不时传来脆裂之声，抬眼望四野焦黄一片，蹙眉吟道：
“久旱乾坤火气浮，枯枝败叶满平芜。
才离烈风惊魂定，又见山隅起赤炉。
天地燥气积郁过甚，遍地皆是易燃之物，只一星半点火星，便能酿成滔天大祸。此际行路，万万大意不得。”
白洁俯身捻起一截枯木，木身轻脆，指尖稍用力便碎作数段，轻声叹曰：
“草木全枯不耐焚，骄阳久照火风熏。
一番灾劫方行过，又遇红焰覆寒村。
人心、兵戈、旱荒、狂风四劫已历，如今第五重火灾大难将至。天灾接连相续，层层相逼，可见红尘炼心，从无半分安逸。”
何月凝神远眺，目光扫过远近山林丘壑，神色渐凝：“前方西南方向，已有淡淡赤光升腾，烟气隐隐弥漫。想来是山野之间先起野火，风助火势，定然蔓延极快。沿途村落危矣。”
公孙离望着连绵不绝的枯野，怅然咏道：
“曾凭圣力扫妖氛，不料凡尘火劫殷。
万里荒原同引焰，可怜生民无处奔。
火借地势，席卷千里，不同于寻常水旱兵戈。烈焰一旦铺开，遮天盖地，进退无路，乃是绝境之厄。”
花月步道：“我等依旧封存神通，不施控水熄焰之术，只以凡人身手奔走救护。亲历烈焰焚野之苦，目睹苍生流离之惨，方能让慈悲道心，扎根凡尘，再无虚浮。”
黄鼬妖趴在肩头，小鼻子不住嗅探，已然闻见远处飘来的焦糊气息，瑟瑟道：“好浓的烟火气！这大火看着吓人极了，草木都干成这样，怕是整片山野都要烧起来，百姓可往哪里逃呀？”
何年神色沉稳，抬手向前一指：“火势已起，蔓延极速，前方数座村落首当其冲。你我分头奔走，一路传警，一路扶弱，能救一人是一人，能护一村是一村。速速前行！”

众人脚下发力，快步疾行。行不出数里，眼前景象已然骇人。
但见：
一点火星起荒冈，转瞬燎原势莫当。
赤焰腾空吞落日，浓烟蔽野隐穹苍。
枯林遇火声声爆，断木逢烟处处茫。
四野绵延四万里，村村户户尽惊慌。
原本焦黄的山野，此刻化作一片赤色火海。烈焰顺着枯草丛、干林木一路疯长，从远处山冈直扑平原，火舌翻腾，高低错落，一路向东向西疯狂蔓延。火光映红半边天际，滚滚黑烟扶摇直上，白日竟暗如昏暮。
火势所过之处，枯枝噼啪爆响，焦灰漫天飞舞。热浪扑面而来，隔着数丈便觉炙烤难耐。沿途接连数座村落，尽数被火头缠上。土坯院墙遇火便焦，茅草屋顶一触即燃，座座屋舍顷刻之间便陷入火海。
村落之中，哭嚎震天。百姓猝不及防，有的被困火屋之内，拼命拍门呼救；有的拖儿带女，衣衫不整，跌跌撞撞向外奔逃；还有年迈体弱、腿脚不便之人，行动迟缓，眼看就要被烈火围困，命悬一线。
“快跑啊！大火烧过来了！”
“屋舍全燃了，快往河边、石滩躲避！”
“爹娘快走！再晚就来不及了！”
呼喊声、哭啼声、火焰噼啪声、屋梁坍塌声搅作一团，人间惨状，目不忍视。
六人不再迟疑，当即分路冲入各村，奔走施救。
何日专挑火势最猛、人群最乱之处穿行。他见村口一座大院四面起火，院内数名老弱被烈焰堵在堂屋门口，进退不得，当即深吸一口气，裹紧衣衫，顶着灼人热浪直冲而入。
火舌在身周翻卷，浓烟呛人眼鼻。他大步奔至堂屋门前，伸手搀扶老者，牵引妇孺，高声喝道：“莫要慌乱，随我往外走！弯腰掩面，避开火头！”
一行人贴着墙根，借着火势间隙快步撤离。将众人送至村外安全地带后，何日立在旷野回望燃塌的宅院，慨然吟道：
“烈焰横空势若狂，村庐转瞬化焦塘。
生民历尽千般苦，又被红涛断故乡。”
白洁穿行在街巷之间，专寻被困孩童与体弱妇人。有几名稚童贪玩滞后，被断墙与火路隔开，吓得缩在墙角啼哭。她快步上前，以衣袖护住孩童口鼻，俯身引路，避开飞窜的火星与坠落的木梁。行至安全处，柔声安抚，又指点乡民开辟隔火之路：

“荒野连天火不休，速清柴草断源流。
众人齐心开隔道，莫使红焰再深游。”
content_en:
The poem says:
At the beginning of the storm, the dust is cool, and the red ground is dry and causing fire.
Thousands of miles of beacon smoke continue to fall, and the flames of thousands of villages are heart-breaking.
Everyone left Fengling Village and continued to move west. The drought has been going on for a long time, and the dry air in the world has condensed and never dispersed. The vegetation in the fields has long been as dry as charcoal, and the loess everywhere is as dry and hard as pottery. Even the wind carries a burning smell. A strong wind had just passed by, breaking trees and raising dust. Broken branches and leaves were scattered everywhere. There were fire starters and hidden dangers everywhere.
One day, I was walking on the road, stepping on dead branches, and heard the sound of cracking in my ears from time to time. I looked up at the scorched fields around me, frowned and said:
“The world has been in a drought for a long time, and the fire and air are floating around, and the dead branches and leaves are all flat and weedy.
Just when the strong wind left me and I was frightened, I saw a red stove rising in the corner of the mountain.
The heaven and earth are too dry and stagnant, and there are flammable things everywhere. Just a little spark can cause a huge disaster. Don't be careless when traveling at this time. "
Bai Jie leaned over and twisted up a piece of dead wood. The wood was light and brittle, and it broke into several pieces with just a little force on her fingertips. She sighed softly:
“The vegetation is all withered and cannot withstand burning, and the scorching sun shines for a long time and the wind smokes the fire.
After passing through a series of disasters, we encountered red flames covering the cold village.
The four calamities of human heart, war, drought, and strong winds have been experienced, and now the fifth level of fire disaster is approaching. Natural disasters come one after another, forcing each other one after another. It can be seen that the human world is hardening the heart, and there is never any ease. "
He Yue looked intently into the distance, his eyes sweeping over the mountains and ravines far and near, his expression gradually condensing: "In the southwest direction ahead, there is a faint red light rising, and smoke is faintly filling the air. It seems that a wildfire started in the mountains and fields, and the wind will help the fire, which must spread very quickly. The villages along the way are in danger."
Gongsun Li looked at the endless dry fields and chanted sadly:
“I once relied on the holy power to sweep away the demonic atmosphere, but unexpectedly, the mortal world was devastated by fire.
Thousands of miles of wasteland are burning together, and the poor people have nowhere to run.
Fire takes advantage of the terrain and sweeps thousands of miles, which is different from ordinary floods and droughts. Once the flames spread out, covering the sky and covering the earth, and there is no way to advance or retreat, it is a desperate situation. "
Huayue Trail: "We still seal up our magical powers and do not use the art of controlling water and extinguishing flames. We only run to rescue people with our mortal hands. Only by experiencing the pain of burning the wilderness and witnessing the misery of the people being displaced can we let our compassionate heart take root in the mortal world and no longer be vain."
The yellow weasel demon was lying on his shoulder, sniffing with his little nose. He could already smell the burnt smell floating in the distance, and whispered: "What a strong smoke and smoke! This fire looks very scary. The grass and trees are so dry. I am afraid that the whole mountain will be burned. Where can the people escape?"
He Nian looked calm, raised his hand and pointed forward: "The fire has started and is spreading extremely fast. Several villages in front are bearing the brunt. You and I run separately, sending warnings and supporting the weak along the way. If you can save one person, you are one person, and if you can protect a village, it is a village. Move forward quickly!"
Everyone exerted force under their feet and walked quickly. After walking only a few miles, the scene in front of us was already horrifying.
But see:
A spark rises from the barren hills, and a prairie fire can be set ablaze in an instant.
Red flames soared into the sky and swallowed up the setting sun, and thick smoke covered the fields and the sky.
When the dry forest encounters fire, the sound explodes, and when the broken trees encounter smoke, there is everywhere.
The four fields stretched for 40,000 miles, and every household in every village was panicked.
The originally scorched mountains and fields now turned into a sea of ​​red fire. The flames grew wildly along the withered grass and dry trees, and rushed from the distant mountains to the plains. The flames were billowing, scattered high and low, and spread crazily east and west. The fire reflected half of the sky red, billowing black smoke rose straight up, and the day turned as dark as dusk.
Wherever the fire passed, dead branches crackled and charred ash flew all over the sky. A heat wave hit my face, and I felt unbearably scorching even a few feet away. Several villages along the way were all caught in the fire. The adobe courtyard walls scorched when exposed to fire, the thatched roofs ignited at a touch, and all the houses were instantly engulfed in flames.
In the village, the sky was filled with cries and howls. The people were caught off guard. Some were trapped in the fire house, banging on the door and calling for help; some dragged their children and daughters, and stumbled out in disheveled clothes; there were also those who were old and weak, with inconvenient legs and feet, who moved slowly and were about to be surrounded by the flames, hanging on by a thread.
"Run quickly! The fire is coming!"
"The house is all on fire. Hurry and take shelter by the river or the rocky beach!""Mom, dad, let's go! It's too late!"
Shouts, cries, crackling flames, and the sound of roof beams collapsing all mixed together, and the tragic situation in the world was unbearable to look at.
The six people no longer hesitated, and immediately rushed into each village in different directions, running to rescue.
On a day when the fire is the fiercest and the crowds are the most chaotic, we will walk through it. He saw a large courtyard at the entrance of the village with fire on all sides. Several old and weak people in the courtyard were blocked by the flames at the door of the main room, unable to move forward or retreat. He immediately took a deep breath, wrapped up his clothes, and rushed in despite the scorching heat.
Tongues of fire rolled around him, and thick smoke choked his eyes and nose. He strode to the door of the hall, stretched out his hand to support the old man, led the women and children, and shouted loudly: "Don't panic, just follow me out! Bend down and cover your face to avoid the fire!"
A group of people clung to the wall and evacuated quickly while taking advantage of the fire. After sending everyone to a safe area outside the village, Heri stood in the wilderness and looked back at the burned house, chanting with emotion:
"Fire flames spread across the sky like crazy, and the villages turned into scorched ponds in an instant.
The living people went through all sorts of hardships, and were cut off from their hometown by the red tide. "
Bai Jie walked through the streets, looking for trapped children and frail women. There were a few children who were too lazy to play and were separated from the fire path by a broken wall. They were so frightened that they huddled in the corner and cried. She stepped forward quickly, covering the child's mouth and nose with her sleeves, and leaned down to lead the way, avoiding the flying sparks and falling wooden beams. Walking to a safe place, he comforted the villagers softly, and then directed the villagers to open a way to separate themselves from the fire:
“The fire in the wilderness is endless, and the firewood and grass are quickly cleared and the flow of firewood is cut off.
Everyone works together to open a path to prevent the red flames from swimming deeper. "
